{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/.claude/skills/frontend-playbook\n\n# Frontend Playbook\n\n## What You Probably Got Wrong\n\n**\"I'll use `yarn chain`.\"** Wrong. `yarn chain` gives you an empty local chain with no protocols, no tokens, no state. `yarn fork --network base` gives you a copy of real Base with Uniswap, Aave, USDC, real whale balances — everything (verified addresses: `addresses/SKILL.md`). Always fork.\n\n**\"I deployed to IPFS and it works.\"** Did the CID change? If not, you deployed stale output. Did routes work? Without `trailingSlash: true`, every route except `/` returns 404. Did you check the OG image? Without `NEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_URL`, it points to `localhost:3000`.\n\n**\"I'll set up the project manually.\"** Don't. `npx create-eth@latest` handles everything — Foundry, Next.js, RainbowKit, scaffold hooks. Never run `forge init` or create Next.js projects from scratch.\n\n---\n\n## Fork Mode Setup\n\n### Why Fork, Not Chain\n\n```\nyarn chain (WRONG)              yarn fork --network base (CORRECT)\n└─ Empty local chain            └─ Fork of real Base mainnet\n└─ No protocols                 └─ Uniswap, Aave, etc. available\n└─ No tokens                    └─ Real USDC, WETH exist\n└─ Testing in isolation         └─ Test against REAL state\n```\n\n### Setup\n\n```bash\nnpx create-eth@latest          # Select: foundry, target chain, name\ncd <project-name>\nyarn install\nyarn fork --network base       # Terminal 1: fork of real Base\nyarn deploy                    # Terminal 2: deploy contracts to fork\nyarn start                     # Terminal 3: Next.js frontend\n```\n\n### Critical: Chain ID Gotcha\n\n**When using fork mode, the frontend target network MUST be `chains.foundry` (chain ID 31337), NOT the chain you're forking.**\n\nThe fork runs locally on Anvil with chain ID 31337. Even if you're forking Base:\n\n```typescript\n// scaffold.config.ts during development\ntargetNetworks: [chains.foundry],  // ✅ NOT chains.base!\n```\n\nOnly switch to `chains.base` when deploying contracts to the REAL network.\n\n### Enable Block Mining\n\n```bash\n# In a new terminal — REQUIRED for time-dependent logic\ncast rpc anvil_setIntervalMining 1\n```\n\nWithout this, `block.timestamp` stays FROZEN. Any contract logic using timestamps (deadlines, expiry, vesting) will break silently.\n\n**Make it permanent** by editing `packages/foundry/package.json` to add `--block-time 1` to the fork script.\n\n---\n\n## Deploying to IPFS (Recommended)\n\nIPFS is the recommended deploy path for SE2. Avoids Vercel's memory limits entirely. Produces a fully decentralized static site.\n\n### Full Build Command\n\n```bash\ncd packages/nextjs\nrm -rf .next out  # ALWAYS clean first\n\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_URL=\"https://yourapp.yourname.eth.link\" \\\n  NODE_OPTIONS=\"--require ./polyfill-localstorage.cjs\" \\\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_BUILD=true \\\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_IGNORE_BUILD_ERROR=true \\\n  yarn build\n\n# Upload to BuidlGuidl IPFS\nyarn bgipfs upload out\n# Save the CID!\n```\n\n### Node 25+ localStorage Polyfill (REQUIRED)\n\nNode.js 25+ ships a built-in `localStorage` object that's MISSING standard WebStorage API methods (`getItem`, `setItem`). This breaks `next-themes`, RainbowKit, and any library that calls `localStorage.getItem()` during static page generation.\n\n**Error you'll see:**\n```\nTypeError: localStorage.getItem is not a function\nError occurred prerendering page \"/_not-found\"\n```\n\n**The fix:** Create `polyfill-localstorage.cjs` in `packages/nextjs/`:\n```javascript\nif (typeof globalThis.localStorage !== \"undefined\" &&\n    typeof globalThis.localStorage.getItem !== \"function\") {\n  const store = new Map();\n  globalThis.localStorage = {\n    getItem: (key) => store.get(key) ?? null,\n    setItem: (key, value) => store.set(key, String(value)),\n    removeItem: (key) => store.delete(key),\n    clear: () => store.clear(),\n    key: (index) => [...store.keys()][index] ?? null,\n    get length() { return store.size; },\n  };\n}\n```\n\n**Why `--require` and not `instrumentation.ts`?** Next.js spawns a separate build worker process for prerendering. `--require` injects into EVERY Node process (including workers). `next.config.ts` polyfill only runs in the main process. `instrumentation.ts` doesn't run in the build worker. Only `--require` works.\n\n### IPFS Routing — Why Routes Break\n\nIPFS gateways serve static files. No server handles routing. Three things MUST be true:\n\n**1. `output: \"export\"` in next.config.ts** — generates static HTML files.\n\n**2. `trailingSlash: true` (CRITICAL)** — This is the #1 reason routes break:\n- `trailingSlash: false` (default) → generates `debug.html`\n- `trailingSlash: true` → generates `debug/index.html`\n- IPFS gateways resolve directories to `index.html` automatically, but NOT bare filenames\n- Without trailing slash: `/debug` → 404 ❌\n- With trailing slash: `/debug` → `debug/` → `debug/index.html` ✅\n\n**3. Pages must survive static prerendering** — any page that crashes during `yarn build` (browser APIs at import time, localStorage) gets skipped silently → 404 on IPFS.\n\n**The complete IPFS-safe next.config.ts pattern:**\n```typescript\nconst isIpfs = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_BUILD === \"true\";\nif (isIpfs) {\n  nextConfig.output = \"export\";\n  nextConfig.trailingSlash = true;\n  nextConfig.images = { unoptimized: true };\n}\n```\n\n**SE2's block explorer pages** use `localStorage` at import time and crash during static export. Rename `app/blockexplorer` to `app/_blockexplorer-disabled` if not needed.\n\n### Stale Build Detection\n\n**The #1 IPFS footgun:** You edit code, then deploy the OLD build.\n\n```bash\n# MANDATORY after ANY code change:\nrm -rf .next out                     # 1. Delete old artifacts\n# ... run full build command ...     # 2. Rebuild from scratch\ngrep -l \"YOUR_STRING\" out/_next/static/chunks/app/*.js  # 3. Verify changes present\n\n# Timestamp check:\nstat -f '%Sm' app/page.tsx           # Source modified time\nstat -f '%Sm' out/                   # Build output time\n# Source NEWER than out/ = STALE BUILD. Rebuild first!\n```\n\n**The CID is proof:** If the IPFS CID didn't change after a deploy, you deployed the same content. A real code change ALWAYS produces a new CID.\n\n### Verify Routes After Deploy\n\n```bash\nls out/*/index.html                  # Each route has a directory + index.html\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" -L \"https://GATEWAY/ipfs/CID/debug/\"\n# Should return 200, not 404\n```\n\n---\n\n## Deploying to Vercel (Alternative)\n\nSE2 is a monorepo — Vercel needs special configuration.\n\n### Configuration\n\n1. **Root Directory:** `packages/nextjs`\n2. **Install Command:** `cd ../.. && yarn install`\n3. **Build Command:** leave default (`next build`)\n4. **Output Directory:** leave default (`.next`)\n\n```bash\n# Via API:\ncurl -X PATCH \"https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/PROJECT_ID\" \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $VERCEL_TOKEN\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"rootDirectory\": \"packages/nextjs\", \"installCommand\": \"cd ../.. && yarn install\"}'\n```\n\n### Common Failures\n\n| Error | Cause | Fix |\n|-------|-------|-----|\n| \"No Next.js version detected\" | Root Directory not set | Set to `packages/nextjs` |\n| \"cd packages/nextjs: No such file\" | Build command has `cd` | Clear it — root dir handles this |\n| OOM / exit code 129 | SE2 monorepo exceeds 8GB | Use IPFS instead, or `vercel --prebuilt` |\n\n### Decision Tree\n\n```\nWant to deploy SE2?\n├─ IPFS (recommended) → yarn ipfs / manual build + upload\n│   └─ Fully decentralized, no memory limits, works with ENS\n├─ Vercel → Set rootDirectory + installCommand\n│   └─ Fast CDN, but centralized. May OOM on large projects\n└─ vercel --prebuilt → Build locally, push artifacts to Vercel\n    └─ Best of both: local build power + Vercel CDN\n```\n\n---\n\n## ENS Subdomain Setup\n\nTwo mainnet transactions to point an ENS subdomain at your IPFS deployment.\n\n### Transaction 1: Create Subdomain (new apps only)\n\n1. Open `https://app.ens.domains/yourname.eth`\n2. Go to \"Subnames\" tab → \"New subname\"\n3. Enter the label (e.g. `myapp`) → Next → Skip profile → Open Wallet → Confirm\n4. If gas is stuck: switch MetaMask to Ethereum → Activity tab → \"Speed up\"\n\n### Transaction 2: Set IPFS Content Hash\n\n1. Navigate to `https://app.ens.domains/myapp.yourname.eth`\n2. \"Records\" tab → \"Edit Records\" → \"Other\" tab\n3. Paste in Content Hash field: `ipfs://<CID>`\n4. Save → Open Wallet → Confirm in MetaMask\n\nFor **updates** to an existing app: skip Tx 1, only do Tx 2.\n\n### Verify\n\n```bash\n# 1. Onchain content hash matches\nRESOLVER=$(cast call 0x00000000000C2e074eC69A0dFb2997BA6C7d2e1e \\\n  \"resolver(bytes32)(address)\" $(cast namehash myapp.yourname.eth) \\\n  --rpc-url https://eth.llamarpc.com)\ncast call $RESOLVER \"contenthash(bytes32)(bytes)\" \\\n  $(cast namehash myapp.yourname.eth) --rpc-url https://eth.llamarpc.com\n\n# 2. Gateway responds (may take 5-15 min for cache)\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" -L \"https://myapp.yourname.eth.link\"\n\n# 3. OG metadata correct (not localhost)\ncurl -s -L \"https://myapp.yourname.eth.link\" | grep 'og:image'\n```\n\n**Use `.eth.link` NOT `.eth.limo`** — `.eth.link` works better on mobile.\n\n---\n\n## Go to Production — Complete Checklist\n\nWhen the user says \"ship it\", follow this EXACT sequence.\n\n### Step 1: Final Code Review 🤖\n- All feedback incorporated\n- No duplicate h1, no raw addresses, no shared isLoading\n- `scaffold.config.ts` has `rpcOverrides` and `pollingInterval: 3000`\n\n### Step 2: Choose Domain 👤\nAsk: *\"What subdomain do you want? e.g. `myapp.yourname.eth` → `myapp.yourname.eth.link`\"*\n\n### Step 3: Generate OG Image + Fix Metadata 🤖\n- Create 1200×630 PNG (`public/thumbnail.png`) — NOT the stock SE2 thumbnail\n- Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_URL` to the live domain\n- Verify `og:image` will resolve to an absolute production URL\n\n### Step 4: Clean Build + IPFS Deploy 🤖\n```bash\ncd packages/nextjs && rm -rf .next out\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_URL=\"https://myapp.yourname.eth.link\" \\\n  NODE_OPTIONS=\"--require ./polyfill-localstorage.cjs\" \\\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_BUILD=true NEXT_PUBLIC_IGNORE_BUILD_ERROR=true \\\n  yarn build\n\n# Verify before uploading:\nls out/*/index.html                        # Routes exist\ngrep 'og:image' out/index.html             # Not localhost\nstat -f '%Sm' app/page.tsx                 # Source older than out/\nstat -f '%Sm' out/\n\nyarn bgipfs upload out                     # Save the CID\n```\n\n### Step 5: Share for Approval 👤\nSend: *\"Build ready for review: `https://community.bgipfs.com/ipfs/<CID>`\"*\n**Wait for approval before touching ENS.**\n\n### Step 6: Set ENS 🤖\nCreate subdomain (if new) + set IPFS content hash. Two mainnet transactions.\n\n### Step 7: Verify 🤖\n- Content hash matches onchain\n- `.eth.link` gateway responds with 200\n- OG image loads correctly\n- Routes work (`/debug/`, etc.)\n\n### Step 8: Report 👤\n*\"Live at `https://myapp.yourname.eth.link` — ENS content hash confirmed onchain, unfurl metadata set.\"*\n\n---\n\n## Build Verification Process\n\nA build is NOT done when the code compiles. It's done when you've tested it like a real user.\n\n### Phase 1: Code QA (Automated)\n- Scan `.tsx` files for raw address strings (should use `<Address/>`)\n- Scan for shared `isLoading` state across multiple buttons\n- Scan for missing `disabled` props on transaction buttons\n- Verify RPC config and polling interval\n- Verify OG metadata with absolute URLs\n- Verify no public RPCs in any file\n\n### Phase 2: Smart Contract Testing\n```bash\nforge test                    # All tests pass\nforge test --fuzz-runs 10000  # Fuzz testing\n```\nTest edge cases: zero amounts, max amounts, unauthorized callers, reentrancy attempts.\n\n### Phase 3: Browser Testing (THE REAL TEST)\n\nOpen the app and do a FULL walkthrough:\n\n1. **Load the app** — does it render correctly?\n2. **Check page title** — is it correct, not \"Scaffold-ETH 2\"?\n3. **Connect wallet** — does the connect flow work?\n4. **Wrong network** — connect on wrong chain, verify \"Switch to Base\" appears\n5. **Switch network** — click the switch button, verify it works\n6. **Approve flow** — verify approve button shows, click it, wait for tx, verify action button appears\n7. **Main action** — click primary action, verify loader, wait for tx, verify state updates\n8. **Error handling** — reject a transaction in wallet, verify UI recovers\n9. **Address displays** — all addresses showing ENS/blockies, not raw hex?\n10. **Share URL** — check OG unfurl (image, title, description)\n\n### Phase 4: QA Sub-Agent (Complex Builds)\nFor bigger projects, spawn a sub-agent with fresh context. Give it the repo path and deployed URL. It reads all code against the UX rules, opens a browser, clicks through independently, and reports issues.\n\n---\n\n## Don't Do These\n\n- ❌ `yarn chain` — use `yarn fork --network <chain>`\n- ❌ `forge init` — use `npx create-eth@latest`\n- ❌ Manual Next.js setup — SE2 handles it\n- ❌ Manual wallet connection — SE2 has RainbowKit pre-configured\n- ❌ Edit `deployedContracts.ts` — it's auto-generated by `yarn deploy`\n- ❌ Hardcode API keys in `scaffold.config.ts` — use `.env.local`\n- ❌ Use `mainnet.base.org` in production — use Alchemy or similar\n\n---\n\n## Resources\n\n- **SE2 Docs:** https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/\n- **UI Components:** https://ui.scaffoldeth.io/\n- **SpeedRun Ethereum:** https://speedrunethereum.com/\n- **ETH Tech Tree:** https://www.ethtechtree.com\n- **BuidlGuidl IPFS:** https://upload.bgipfs.com\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"119f677a-f772-4065-9b16-8f8343dffdde","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:05:12.743Z","isSynthetic":true}

^0.8.19;\n\nimport \"./DeployHelpers.s.sol\";\nimport { DeployYourContract } from \"./DeployYourContract.s.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @notice Main deployment script for all contracts\n * @dev Run this when you want to deploy multiple contracts at once\n *\n * Example: yarn deploy # runs this script(without`--file` flag)\n */\ncontract DeployScript is ScaffoldETHDeploy {\n  function run() external {\n    // Deploys all your contracts sequentially\n    // Add new deployments here when needed\n\n    \n    DeployYourContract deployYourContract = new DeployYourContract();\n    deployYourContract.run();\n\n\n    // Deploy another contract\n    // DeployMyContract myContract = new DeployMyContract();\n    // myContract.run();\n  }\n}===DeployYourContract===\n// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.19;\n\nimport \"./DeployHelpers.s.sol\";\nimport \"../contracts/YourContract.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @notice Deploy script for YourContract contract\n * @dev Inherits ScaffoldETHDeploy which:\n *      - Includes forge-std/Script.sol for deployment\n *      - Includes ScaffoldEthDeployerRunner modifier\n *      - Provides `deployer` variable\n * Example:\n * yarn deploy --file DeployYourContract.s.sol  # local anvil chain\n * yarn deploy --file DeployYourContract.s.sol --network optimism # live network (requires keystore)\n */\ncontract DeployYourContract is ScaffoldETHDeploy {\n    /**\n     * @dev Deployer setup based on `ETH_KEYSTORE_ACCOUNT` in `.env`:\n     *      - \"scaffold-eth-default\": Uses Anvil's account #9 (0xa0Ee7A142d267C1f36714E4a8F75612F20a79720), no password prompt\n     *      - \"scaffold-eth-custom\": requires password used while creating keystore\n     *\n     * Note: Must use ScaffoldEthDeployerRunner modifier to:\n     *      - Setup correct `deployer` account and fund it\n     *      - Export contract addresses & ABIs to `nextjs` packages\n     */\n    function run() external ScaffoldEthDeployerRunner {\n        new YourContract(deployer);\n    }\n}\n===DeployHelpers head===\n//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.19;\n\nimport { Script, console } from \"forge-std/Script.sol\";\nimport { Vm } from \"forge-std/Vm.sol\";\n\ncontract ScaffoldETHDeploy is Script {\n    error InvalidChain();\n    error DeployerHasNoBalance();\n    error InvalidPrivateKey(string);\n\n    event AnvilSetBalance(address account, uint256 amount);\n    event FailedAnvilRequest();\n\n    struct Deployment {\n        string name;\n        address addr;\n    }\n\n    string root;\n    string path;\n    Deployment[] public deployments;\n    uint256 constant ANVIL_BASE_BALANCE = 10000 ether;\n\n    /// @notice The deployer address for every run\n    address deployer;\n\n    /// @notice Use this modifier on your run() function on your deploy scripts\n    modifier ScaffoldEthDeployerRunner() {\n        deployer = _startBroadcast();\n        if (deployer == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidPrivateKey(\"Invalid private key\");\n        }\n        _;\n        _stopBroadcast();\n        exportDeployments();\n    }\n\n    function _startBroadcast() internal returns (address) {\n        vm.startBroadcast();\n        (, address _deployer,) = vm.readCallers();\n\n        if (block.chainid == 31337 && _deployer.balance == 0) {\n            try vm.deal(_deployer, ANVIL_BASE_BALANCE) {\n                emit AnvilSetBalance(_deployer, ANVIL_BASE_BALANCE);\n            } catch {\n                emit FailedAnvilRequest();\n            }\n        }\n        return _deployer;\n    }\n\n    function _stopBroadcast() internal {\n        vm.stopBroadcast();\n    }\n\n    function exportDeployments() internal {\n        // fetch already existing contracts\n        root = vm.projectRoot();\n        path = string.concat(root, \"/deployments/\");","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"7b1ccde5-7336-492f-951e-f3d4ec311fe7","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:07:19.142Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"===Deploy.s.sol===\n//SPDX-License-Identifier: {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdMeKXoEURpyWAvqmmHJk","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013jzCkJp2NVAa9k91Vky6f8","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/packages/foundry/contracts/TipJar.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.19;\n\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport { Ownable } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport { ReentrancyGuard } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title TipJar\n * @notice A public tip jar that accepts tips in a single ERC20 token (USDC on Base).\n *         Every tip is recorded on-chain with an optional message, forming a public\n *         \"tip feed\" that anyone can read. The owner can withdraw the collected balance.\n * @dev The tip token is fixed at deploy time. Tippers must `approve` this contract to\n *      spend their USDC before calling `tip`.\n */\ncontract TipJar is Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @notice The ERC20 token accepted as tips (USDC on Base, 6 decimals).\n    IERC20 public immutable token;\n\n    struct Tip {\n        address from; // who sent the tip\n        uint256 amount; // amount in token's smallest unit (USDC has 6 decimals)\n        string message; // optional message left with the tip\n        uint256 timestamp; // block time the tip was recorded\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Chronological feed of every tip ever sent.\n    Tip[] public tips;\n\n    /// @notice Total amount tipped, in the token's smallest unit.\n    uint256 public totalTipped;\n\n    /// @notice Total amount tipped per address, in the token's smallest unit.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public tippedBy;\n\n    event NewTip(address indexed from, uint256 amount, string message, uint256 timestamp);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error MessageTooLong();\n\n    /// @param _token   Address of the ERC20 tip token (Base USDC).\n    /// @param _owner   Address that can withdraw collected tips.\n    constructor(address _token, address _owner) Ownable(_owner) {\n        require(_token != address(0), \"token is zero address\");\n        token = IERC20(_token);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Send a tip. Requires a prior `approve` on the token for at least `amount`.\n     * @param amount  Amount of token to tip (USDC uses 6 decimals, e.g. 1 USDC = 1_000_000).\n     * @param message Optional message (max 280 chars) shown in the feed.\n     */\n    function tip(uint256 amount, string calldata message) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (bytes(message).length > 280) revert MessageTooLong();\n\n        // Pull the tip in. SafeERC20 reverts if the transfer fails.\n        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n\n        tips.push(Tip({ from: msg.sender, amount: amount, message: message, timestamp: block.timestamp }));\n        totalTipped += amount;\n        tippedBy[msg.sender] += amount;\n\n        emit NewTip(msg.sender, amount, message, block.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Number of tips in the feed.\n    function tipCount() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return tips.length;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Return the entire tip feed.\n    function getAllTips() external view returns (Tip[] memory) {\n        return tips;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Return up to `count` most recent tips, newest first.\n     * @param count Maximum number of tips to return.\n     */\n    function getRecentTips(uint256 count) external view returns (Tip[] memory) {\n        uint256 total = tips.length;\n        if (count > total) count = total;\n        Tip[] memory recent = new Tip[](count);\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n            recent[i] = tips[total - 1 - i];\n        }\n        return recent;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current token balance held by the jar (equals un-withdrawn tips).\n    function jarBalance() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return token.balanceOf(address(this));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw the full jar balance to the owner.\n    function withdraw() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {\n        uint256 balance = token.balanceOf(address(this));\n        if (balance == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        token.safeTransfer(owner(), balance);\n        emit Withdrawn(owner(), balance);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":649,"cache_read_input_tokens":38268,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":649},"output_tokens":51,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"1d8e816e-046c-474c-aa7d-ea41c088267a","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:08:06.022Z","request_id":"req_011CdMeKWgWcDT1SiMf5qcN8"}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013jzCkJp2NVAa9k91Vky6f8","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/packages/foundry/contracts/TipJar.sol (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"d8106700-941c-4ad1-aace-dea34a4d1171","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:08:06.031Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/packages/foundry/contracts/TipJar.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.19;\n\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport { Ownable } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport { ReentrancyGuard } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title TipJar\n * @notice A public tip jar that accepts tips in a single ERC20 token (USDC on Base).\n *         Every tip is recorded on-chain with an optional message, forming a public\n *         \"tip feed\" that anyone can read. The owner can withdraw the collected balance.\n * @dev The tip token is fixed at deploy time. Tippers must `approve` this contract to\n *      spend their USDC before calling `tip`.\n */\ncontract TipJar is Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @notice The ERC20 token accepted as tips (USDC on Base, 6 decimals).\n    IERC20 public immutable token;\n\n    struct Tip {\n        address from; // who sent the tip\n        uint256 amount; // amount in token's smallest unit (USDC has 6 decimals)\n        string message; // optional message left with the tip\n        uint256 timestamp; // block time the tip was recorded\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Chronological feed of every tip ever sent.\n    Tip[] public tips;\n\n    /// @notice Total amount tipped, in the token's smallest unit.\n    uint256 public totalTipped;\n\n    /// @notice Total amount tipped per address, in the token's smallest unit.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public tippedBy;\n\n    event NewTip(address indexed from, uint256 amount, string message, uint256 timestamp);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error MessageTooLong();\n\n    /// @param _token   Address of the ERC20 tip token (Base USDC).\n    /// @param _owner   Address that can withdraw collected tips.\n    constructor(address _token, address _owner) Ownable(_owner) {\n        require(_token != address(0), \"token is zero address\");\n        token = IERC20(_token);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Send a tip. Requires a prior `approve` on the token for at least `amount`.\n     * @param amount  Amount of token to tip (USDC uses 6 decimals, e.g. 1 USDC = 1_000_000).\n     * @param message Optional message (max 280 chars) shown in the feed.\n     */\n    function tip(uint256 amount, string calldata message) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (bytes(message).length > 280) revert MessageTooLong();\n\n        // Pull the tip in. SafeERC20 reverts if the transfer fails.\n        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n\n        tips.push(Tip({ from: msg.sender, amount: amount, message: message, timestamp: block.timestamp }));\n        totalTipped += amount;\n        tippedBy[msg.sender] += amount;\n\n        emit NewTip(msg.sender, amount, message, block.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Number of tips in the feed.\n    function tipCount() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return tips.length;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Return the entire tip feed.\n    function getAllTips() external view returns (Tip[] memory) {\n        return tips;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Return up to `count` most recent tips, newest first.\n     * @param count Maximum number of tips to return.\n     */\n    function getRecentTips(uint256 count) external view returns (Tip[] memory) {\n        uint256 total = tips.length;\n        if (count > total) count = total;\n        Tip[] memory recent = new Tip[](count);\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n            recent[i] = tips[total - 1 - i];\n        }\n        return recent;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current token balance held by the jar (equals un-withdrawn tips).\n    function jarBalance() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return token.balanceOf(address(this));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw the full jar balance to the owner.\n    function withdraw() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {\n        uint256 balance = token.balanceOf(address(this));\n        if (balance == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        token.safeTransfer(owner(), balance);\n        emit Withdrawn(owner(), balance);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdMeP58y3yi6rciTt6ZZP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Ho13UVehSgQbbjbMe2Pv9C","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/packages/foundry/test/TipJar.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.19;\n\nimport \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport \"../contracts/TipJar.sol\";\nimport { ERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n\n/// @dev Minimal 6-decimal ERC20 standing in for USDC in unit tests.\ncontract MockUSDC is ERC20 {\n    constructor() ERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\") {}\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n}\n\ncontract TipJarTest is Test {\n    TipJar public jar;\n    MockUSDC public usdc;\n\n    address owner = address(0xABCD);\n    address alice = address(0xA11CE);\n    address bob = address(0xB0B);\n\n    uint256 constant ONE_USDC = 1_000_000; // 6 decimals\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdc = new MockUSDC();\n        jar = new TipJar(address(usdc), owner);\n        usdc.mint(alice, 100 * ONE_USDC);\n        usdc.mint(bob, 100 * ONE_USDC);\n    }\n\n    function _tip(address who, uint256 amount, string memory msg_) internal {\n        vm.startPrank(who);\n        usdc.approve(address(jar), amount);\n        jar.tip(amount, msg_);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function testDeployment() public view {\n        assertEq(address(jar.token()), address(usdc));\n        assertEq(jar.owner(), owner);\n        assertEq(jar.totalTipped(), 0);\n        assertEq(jar.tipCount(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function testTipRecordsFeedAndTransfers() public {\n        _tip(alice, 5 * ONE_USDC, \"gm\");\n\n        assertEq(jar.tipCount(), 1);\n        assertEq(jar.totalTipped(), 5 * ONE_USDC);\n        assertEq(jar.tippedBy(alice), 5 * ONE_USDC);\n        assertEq(jar.jarBalance(), 5 * ONE_USDC);\n        assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(alice), 95 * ONE_USDC);\n\n        (address from, uint256 amount, string memory message,) = jar.tips(0);\n        assertEq(from, alice);\n        assertEq(amount, 5 * ONE_USDC);\n        assertEq(message, \"gm\");\n    }\n\n    function testMultipleTipsAndRecentOrder() public {\n        _tip(alice, 1 * ONE_USDC, \"first\");\n        _tip(bob, 2 * ONE_USDC, \"second\");\n        _tip(alice, 3 * ONE_USDC, \"third\");\n\n        assertEq(jar.tipCount(), 3);\n        assertEq(jar.totalTipped(), 6 * ONE_USDC);\n        assertEq(jar.tippedBy(alice), 4 * ONE_USDC);\n\n        TipJar.Tip[] memory recent = jar.getRecentTips(2);\n        assertEq(recent.length, 2);\n        assertEq(recent[0].message, \"third\"); // newest first\n        assertEq(recent[1].message, \"second\");\n\n        TipJar.Tip[] memory all = jar.getAllTips();\n        assertEq(all.length, 3);\n        assertEq(all[0].message, \"first\");\n    }\n\n    function testGetRecentTipsClampsToLength() public {\n        _tip(alice, 1 * ONE_USDC, \"only\");\n        TipJar.Tip[] memory recent = jar.getRecentTips(50);\n        assertEq(recent.length, 1);\n    }\n\n    function testTipZeroReverts() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        usdc.approve(address(jar), ONE_USDC);\n        vm.expectRevert(TipJar.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        jar.tip(0, \"nope\");\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function testTipWithoutApprovalReverts() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(); // SafeERC20 reverts on insufficient allowance\n        jar.tip(ONE_USDC, \"no approve\");\n    }\n\n    function testMessageTooLongReverts() public {\n        string memory long = new string(281);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        usdc.approve(address(jar), ONE_USDC);\n        vm.expectRevert(TipJar.MessageTooLong.selector);\n        jar.tip(ONE_USDC, long);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function testWithdrawByOwner() public {\n        _tip(alice, 10 * ONE_USDC, \"thanks\");\n\n        uint256 before = usdc.balanceOf(owner);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        jar.withdraw();\n\n        assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(owner), before + 10 * ONE_USDC);\n        assertEq(jar.jarBalance(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function testWithdrawByNonOwnerReverts() public {\n        _tip(alice, 10 * ONE_USDC, \"thanks\");\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(); // Ownable: caller is not the owner\n        jar.withdraw();\n    }\n\n    function testWithdrawEmptyReverts() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(TipJar.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        jar.withdraw();\n    }\n\n    function testFuzzTip(uint256 amount, uint96 mintExtra) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1, 1_000_000 * ONE_USDC);\n        usdc.mint(alice, amount + mintExtra);\n        uint256 balBefore = usdc.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        usdc.approve(address(jar), amount);\n        jar.tip(amount, \"fuzz\");\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(jar.totalTipped(), amount);\n        assertEq(jar.jarBalance(), amount);\n        assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(alice), balBefore - amount);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":428,"cache_read_input_tokens":43131,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":428},"output_tokens":51,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"42ac88c3-a609-4a85-874b-f6533457a732","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:08:56.932Z","request_id":"req_011CdMeP42k1o4TEiuTSjy6Q"}

// newest first\n        assertEq(recent[1].message, \"second\");\n\n        TipJar.Tip[] memory all = jar.getAllTips();\n        assertEq(all.length, 3);\n        assertEq(all[0].message, \"first\");\n    }\n\n    function testGetRecentTipsClampsToLength() public {\n        _tip(alice, 1 * ONE_USDC, \"only\");\n        TipJar.Tip[] memory recent = jar.getRecentTips(50);\n        assertEq(recent.length, 1);\n    }\n\n    function testTipZeroReverts() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        usdc.approve(address(jar), ONE_USDC);\n        vm.expectRevert(TipJar.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        jar.tip(0, \"nope\");\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function testTipWithoutApprovalReverts() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(); {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdMeg7usxqhKiQzjwapGn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01A4XCKbM8Bf3bb1pFJ4XCgB","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/packages/nextjs/components/tipjar/TipForm.tsx","content":"\"use client\";\n\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { formatUnits, parseUnits } from \"viem\";\nimport { useAccount } from \"wagmi\";\nimport { RainbowKitCustomConnectButton } from \"~~/components/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { useDeployedContractInfo, useScaffoldReadContract, useScaffoldWriteContract } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\n\nconst USDC_DECIMALS = 6;\nconst MAX_MESSAGE = 280;\n\n/**\n * Form to send a USDC tip. Handles the two-step ERC20 flow: approve, then tip.\n */\nexport const TipForm = () => {\n  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();\n\n  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(\"\");\n  const [message, setMessage] = useState(\"\");\n\n  const { data: tipJar } = useDeployedContractInfo({ contractName: \"TipJar\" });\n  const tipJarAddress = tipJar?.address;\n\n  const { data: balance } = useScaffoldReadContract({\n    contractName: \"USDC\",\n    functionName: \"balanceOf\",\n    args: [address],\n  });\n  const { data: allowance } = useScaffoldReadContract({\n    contractName: \"USDC\",\n    functionName: \"allowance\",\n    args: [address, tipJarAddress],\n  });\n\n  const { writeContractAsync: approveAsync, isMining: isApproving } = useScaffoldWriteContract({\n    contractName: \"USDC\",\n  });\n  const { writeContractAsync: tipAsync, isMining: isTipping } = useScaffoldWriteContract({\n    contractName: \"TipJar\",\n  });\n\n  // Parse the amount, tolerating empty / malformed input.\n  let parsedAmount = 0n;\n  try {\n    parsedAmount = amount ? (\n          <div className=\"flex justify-center\">\n            <RainbowKitCustomConnectButton />\n          </div>\n        ) : needsApproval ? {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FjxfonpHASuMYiqZn79mCz","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t---\n2\tname: rainbowkit-wagmi-next-x402-build-fix\n3\tdescription: RainbowKit+wagmi+Next.js dev build fails on @x402 / async-storage optional deps — fix with IgnorePlugin\n4\tmetadata: \n5\t  node_type: memory\n6\t  type: reference\n7\t  originSessionId: d5c57ae0-5ba4-42e5-9286-490e29d2bfcb\n8\t  modified: 2026-07-24T22:04:04.903Z\n9\t---\n10\t\n11\tRainbowKit v2 + wagmi v2 + Next.js (webpack) — both `next dev` and `next build` — throw `Module not found: Can't resolve '@x402/evm/upto/client'` (also seen: `@x402/svm/exact/client`, `@x402/evm`, `@x402/core/client`, `@x402/evm/exact/client`). In `next build` these are hard errors that fail the build. Chain: `@rainbow-me/rainbowkit` → `wagmi/connectors` barrel → `@wagmi/connectors/baseAccount` → `@base-org/account` → `@coinbase/cdp-sdk` lazily `import()`s x402 payment modules that aren't installed. The barrel import means avoiding the Coinbase/Base connector (e.g. via `connectorsForWallets`) does NOT fix it.\n12\t\n13\tFix in `next.config.js` webpack (resolve.alias `false` did NOT work for these subpath dynamic imports; IgnorePlugin does):\n14\t\n15\t```js\n16\twebpack: (config, { webpack }) => {\n17\t  config.plugins.push(new webpack.IgnorePlugin({ resourceRegExp: /^@x402\\// }));\n18\t  // also silences a harmless @metamask/sdk RN warning:\n19\t  config.plugins.push(new webpack.IgnorePlugin({ resourceRegExp: /^@react-native-async-storage\\/async-storage$/ }));\n20\t  return config;\n21\t}\n22\t```\n23\t\n24\tAlso push `'pino-pretty','lokijs','encoding'` to `config.externals`. The ignored modules are never executed at runtime for injected/MetaMask flows.\n25\t\n26\t**Next.js 16 / Turbopack wrinkle (create-eth 2.0.22 scaffolds Next 16.2, `next dev` defaults to Turbopack):** the webpack IgnorePlugin config above is IGNORED by Turbopack, so `next dev` still 500s with `Can't resolve '@x402/svm/exact/client'`. Fix: force webpack — set the nextjs `dev`/`start` scripts to `next dev --webpack` (the `--webpack` flag exists in Next 16). Then the `next.config.ts` webpack IgnorePlugin applies and the page renders. Verified 2026-07-24 building a USDC tip jar on a Base fork.\n27\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"2c6cd8fd-5286-4a08-85ba-804f83a9693d","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:14:31.651Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/spencerfaber/.claude/projects/-Users-spencerfaber-dev-ethskills-evals/memory/rainbowkit-wagmi-next-x402-build-fix.md","content":"---\nname: rainbowkit-wagmi-next-x402-build-fix\ndescription: RainbowKit+wagmi+Next.js dev build fails on @x402 / async-storage optional deps — fix with IgnorePlugin\nmetadata: \n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: d5c57ae0-5ba4-42e5-9286-490e29d2bfcb\n  modified: 2026-07-24T22:04:04.903Z\n---\n\nRainbowKit v2 + wagmi v2 + Next.js (webpack) — both `next dev` and `next build` — throw `Module not found: Can't resolve '@x402/evm/upto/client'` (also seen: `@x402/svm/exact/client`, `@x402/evm`, `@x402/core/client`, `@x402/evm/exact/client`). In `next build` these are hard errors that fail the build. Chain: `@rainbow-me/rainbowkit` → `wagmi/connectors` barrel → `@wagmi/connectors/baseAccount` → `@base-org/account` → `@coinbase/cdp-sdk` lazily `import()`s x402 payment modules that aren't installed. The barrel import means avoiding the Coinbase/Base connector (e.g. via `connectorsForWallets`) does NOT fix it.\n\nFix in `next.config.js` webpack (resolve.alias `false` did NOT work for these subpath dynamic imports; IgnorePlugin does):\n\n```js\nwebpack: (config, { webpack }) => {\n  config.plugins.push(new webpack.IgnorePlugin({ resourceRegExp: /^@x402\\// }));\n  // also silences a harmless @metamask/sdk RN warning:\n  config.plugins.push(new webpack.IgnorePlugin({ resourceRegExp: /^@react-native-async-storage\\/async-storage$/ }));\n  return config;\n}\n```\n\nAlso push `'pino-pretty','lokijs','encoding'` to `config.externals`. The ignored modules are never executed at runtime for injected/MetaMask flows.\n\n**Next.js 16 / Turbopack wrinkle (create-eth 2.0.22 scaffolds Next 16.2, `next dev` defaults to Turbopack):** the webpack IgnorePlugin config above is IGNORED by Turbopack, so `next dev` still 500s with `Can't resolve '@x402/svm/exact/client'`. Fix: force webpack — set the nextjs `dev`/`start` scripts to `next dev --webpack` (the `--webpack` flag exists in Next 16). Then the `next.config.ts` webpack IgnorePlugin applies and the page renders. Verified 2026-07-24 building a USDC tip jar on a Base fork.\n","numLines":27,"startLine":1,"totalLines":27}}}

This shim replaces the\n// broken global with a minimal in-memory implementation. Injected via\n// NODE_OPTIONS=\"--require ./polyfill-localstorage.cjs\".\nif (\n  typeof globalThis.localStorage === \"undefined\" ||\n  typeof globalThis.localStorage.getItem !== \"function\"\n) {\n  const store = new Map();\n  globalThis.localStorage = {\n    getItem: key => (store.has(key) ? store.get(key) : null),\n    setItem: (key, value) => store.set(key, String(value)),\n    removeItem: key => store.delete(key),\n    clear: () => store.clear(),\n    key: index => [...store.keys()][index] ?? null,\n    get length() {\n      return store.size;\n    },\n  };\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":304,"cache_read_input_tokens":89469,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":304},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"31872dbf-ed1c-4852-8a1a-3b7c6d1abf77","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:15:48.088Z","request_id":"req_011CdMeuVVGmQ2X9WmmiLEfc"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdMf26DEsAqy3KufBozYP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01ARAkErNvWBTH3c9GWa6BqG","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/packages/foundry/scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n#\n# Fund an address with test USDC on the local Base fork.\n#\n# On a fork there are no USDC balances for fresh wallets, so this uses Anvil's\n# `anvil_setStorageAt` to write directly into USDC's `balances` mapping (storage\n# slot 9 of the FiatToken implementation). It does NOT change total supply — it's\n# only meant for local testing against the fork.\n#\n# Usage:\n#   ./scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh <address> [amount_in_usdc]\n#\n# Examples:\n#   ./scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh 0xYourWalletAddress            # gives 1000 USDC\n#   ./scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh 0xYourWalletAddress 50         # gives 50 USDC\n#\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDRESS=\"${1:-}\"\nAMOUNT_USDC=\"${2:-1000}\"\nRPC=\"${RPC_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8545}\"\nUSDC=\"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\"\nBALANCES_SLOT=9\n\nif [ -z \"$ADDRESS\" ]; then\n  echo \"Usage: $0 <address> [amount_in_usdc]\" >&2\n  exit 1\nfi\n\n# USDC has 6 decimals. Convert to smallest units and to a 32-byte hex value.\nAMOUNT_UNITS=$(cast to-wei \"$AMOUNT_USDC\" mwei) # mwei = 1e6, matches USDC decimals\nVALUE_HEX=$(cast to-uint256 \"$AMOUNT_UNITS\")\nKEY=$(cast index address \"$ADDRESS\" \"$BALANCES_SLOT\")\n\ncast rpc anvil_setStorageAt \"$USDC\" \"$KEY\" \"$VALUE_HEX\" --rpc-url \"$RPC\" >/dev/null\n\nNEW_BAL=$(cast call \"$USDC\" \"balanceOf(address)(uint256)\" \"$ADDRESS\" --rpc-url \"$RPC\")\necho \"Funded $ADDRESS with $AMOUNT_USDC USDC (raw balanceOf = $NEW_BAL)\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1401,"cache_read_input_tokens":95144,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1401},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"37147152-a707-4759-a39d-2650aa0ae0b3","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:17:29.119Z","request_id":"req_011CdMf1zJnXBEB5hYA38KQ6"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdMfCnddNDGNHSmB5Eqop","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01V1TZ7q5AP64FRkVHFyUAYn","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/spencerfaber/dev/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-playbook-goal-002/2026-07-24T220505Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/tipjar/README.md","content":"# 💸 USDC Tip Jar (Base)\n\nA minimal onchain tip jar for **Base USDC**. Anyone can send a USDC tip with a\nshort message; every tip is recorded onchain and shown in a public feed. The jar\nowner can withdraw the collected USDC.\n\nBuilt with [Scaffold-ETH 2](https://scaffoldeth.io) (Foundry + Next.js + wagmi +\nRainbowKit). It runs entirely against a **local Anvil fork of Base**, so the real\nBase USDC contract (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`) is used as the\ntip token — nothing is deployed to a live network.\n\n---\n\n## What's in here\n\n| Piece | Location |\n| --- | --- |\n| `TipJar` contract | `packages/foundry/contracts/TipJar.sol` |\n| Deploy script | `packages/foundry/script/DeployTipJar.s.sol` |\n| Contract tests | `packages/foundry/test/TipJar.t.sol` |\n| Frontend page | `packages/nextjs/app/page.tsx` |\n| Tip form / feed / stats | `packages/nextjs/components/tipjar/` |\n| Test-USDC funding helper | `packages/foundry/scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh` |\n\n### How the contract works\n\n- `tip(uint256 amount, string message)` pulls `amount` of USDC from the caller\n  (via `transferFrom`, so an ERC-20 `approve` is required first), appends a `Tip`\n  to the onchain feed, and emits `NewTip`.\n- `getAllTips()` / `getRecentTips(n)` / `tipCount()` expose the feed.\n- `totalTipped`, `jarBalance()`, and `tippedBy(address)` expose running totals.\n- `withdraw()` (owner-only) sends the full jar balance to the owner.\n\nUSDC has **6 decimals**, so `1 USDC = 1_000_000` in the smallest unit.\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- **Node.js** (works on Node 20+; tested on Node 25 — see notes below)\n- **Yarn** (v3+, comes with the repo via Corepack)\n- **Foundry** (`forge`, `cast`, `anvil`) — install: https://getfoundry.sh\n- An Ethereum wallet browser extension (e.g. MetaMask) if you want to connect a\n  real wallet. Otherwise the app auto-connects a local **burner wallet**.\n\n---\n\n## Run it locally\n\nYou'll use **three terminals**. Run every command from the project root.\n\n### 1. Install dependencies\n\n```bash\nyarn install\n```\n\n### 2. Terminal 1 — start a fork of Base\n\n```bash\nyarn fork\n```\n\nThis starts Anvil as a fork of Base mainnet on `http://127.0.0.1:8545` with chain\nid `31337` and 1-second block mining. Because it's a real fork, Base USDC already\nexists on it. (Override the RPC with `FORK_URL=<url> yarn fork` if you have your\nown Base endpoint — the default public RPC works but can be slow.)\n\n### 3. Terminal 2 — deploy the TipJar\n\n```bash\nyarn deploy\n```\n\nDeploys `TipJar` pointed at Base USDC and regenerates\n`packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts` for the frontend.\n\n### 4. Terminal 3 — start the frontend\n\n```bash\nyarn start\n```\n\nOpen **http://localhost:3000**. You'll see the jar stats, a tip form, and the\n(initially empty) tip feed.\n\n---\n\n## Sending a tip locally\n\nA freshly-connected wallet on the fork has **no USDC**, so fund it first with the\nincluded helper (uses Anvil's `setStorageAt` to write a test balance — it does not\ntouch total supply and only affects your local fork):\n\n```bash\n# From the project root, in a spare terminal:\ncd packages/foundry\n./scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh <your-wallet-address> 1000   # gives 1000 test USDC\n```\n\nGet `<your-wallet-address>` from the top-right of the app (click the address to\ncopy it). If you're using the built-in burner wallet, that's the address shown in\nthe header.\n\nThen in the UI:\n\n1. **Connect** your wallet (top-right). The burner wallet connects automatically;\n   for MetaMask, add a network with RPC `http://127.0.0.1:8545` and chain id\n   `31337`, and switch to it.\n2. Enter an **amount** (in USDC) and an optional **message**.\n3. Click **Approve USDC** (first time only — this sets the ERC-20 allowance).\n4. Click **Send tip**. The stats and feed update automatically.\n\n---\n\n## Testing the contract\n\n```bash\nyarn foundry:test          # run the test suite\n# or, for fuzzing:\ncd packages/foundry && forge test --fuzz-runs 10000\n```\n\nThe suite (`packages/foundry/test/TipJar.t.sol`) covers the tip flow, the feed\nordering, message-length and zero-amount guards, owner-only withdrawal, and a\nfuzz test — all against a mock 6-decimal USDC.\n\n---\n\n## Notes / gotchas baked into this project\n\nThese are pre-configured so `yarn start` \"just works\"; documented here so you know\nwhy the config differs from a stock Scaffold-ETH 2 app:\n\n- **Local network = `chains.foundry` (31337), not `chains.base`.** The fork runs\n  on Anvil with chain id 31337, so `packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts` targets\n  `chains.foundry`. You'd only switch to `chains.base` to deploy to the real\n  network (which this project intentionally does not do).\n- **Base USDC as an external contract.** `packages/nextjs/contracts/externalContracts.ts`\n  registers USDC (same address on chain 31337 and 8453) so the app can read\n  balances/allowance and call `approve`.\n- **Next.js forced onto webpack.** The `dev`/`start` scripts use `next dev\n  --webpack`. The RainbowKit → wagmi → Base Account connector transitively imports\n  optional `@x402/*` modules that aren't installed; a webpack `IgnorePlugin` in\n  `next.config.ts` ignores them (Turbopack ignores that config, hence `--webpack`).\n- **Node 25 `localStorage` polyfill.** Node 25 ships a built-in `localStorage`\n  missing `getItem`/`setItem`, which crashes SSR. The `dev`/`start` scripts\n  `--require ./polyfill-localstorage.cjs` to shim it.\n\n---\n\n## Not included (by design)\n\nThis deliverable is the **working local project**. It is **not** deployed to any\nnetwork, IPFS, or hosting provider.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":170,"cache_read_input_tokens":108954,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":170},"output_tokens":62,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0b0c57ba-2c84-4779-887f-7a53eb9a91c1","uuid":"75492ba8-2046-49dc-87c6-281a96afd247","timestamp":"2026-07-24T22:19:54.862Z","request_id":"req_011CdMfCkvvqy1bFxEon4eXt"}

For guidance on [routing](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/defining-routes) and configuring [pages/layouts](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/pages-and-layouts) checkout the Next.js documentation.","-- Edit your deployment scripts in `packages/foundry/script`","+## Sending a tip locally"," ","+A freshly-connected wallet on the fork has **no USDC**, so fund it first with the","+included helper (uses Anvil's `setStorageAt` to write a test balance — it does not","+touch total supply and only affects your local fork):"," ","-## Documentation","+```bash","+# From the project root, in a spare terminal:","+cd packages/foundry","+./scripts-js/fund-usdc.sh <your-wallet-address> 1000   # gives 1000 test USDC","+```"," ","-Visit our [docs](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io) to learn how to start building with Scaffold-ETH 2.","+Get `<your-wallet-address>` from the top-right of the app (click the address to","+copy it). If you're using the built-in burner wallet, that's the address shown in","+the header."," ","-To know more about its features, check out our [website](https://scaffoldeth.io).","+Then in the UI:"," ","-## Contributing to Scaffold-ETH 2","+1. **Connect** your wallet (top-right). The burner wallet connects automatically;","+   for MetaMask, add a network with RPC `http://127.0.0.1:8545` and chain id","+   `31337`, and switch to it.","+2. Enter an **amount** (in USDC) and an optional **message**.","+3. Click **Approve USDC** (first time only — this sets the ERC-20 allowance).","+4. Click **Send tip**. The stats and feed update automatically."," ","-We welcome contributions to Scaffold-ETH 2!","+---"," ","-Please see [CONTRIBUTING.MD](https://github.com/scaffold-eth/scaffold-eth-2/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information and guidelines for contributing to Scaffold-ETH 2.","\\ No newline at end of file","+## Testing the contract","+","+```bash","+yarn foundry:test          # run the test suite","+# or, for fuzzing:","+cd packages/foundry && forge test --fuzz-runs 10000","+```","+","+The suite (`packages/foundry/test/TipJar.t.sol`) covers the tip flow, the feed","+ordering, message-length and zero-amount guards, owner-only withdrawal, and a","+fuzz test — all against a mock 6-decimal USDC.","+","+---","+","+## Notes / gotchas baked into this project","+","+These are pre-configured so `yarn start` \"just works\"; documented here so you know","+why the config differs from a stock Scaffold-ETH 2 app:","+","+- **Local network = `chains.foundry` (31337), not `chains.base`.** The fork runs","+  on Anvil with chain id 31337, so `packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts` targets","+  `chains.foundry`. You'd only switch to `chains.base` to deploy to the real","+  network (which this project intentionally does not do).","+- **Base USDC as an external contract.** `packages/nextjs/contracts/externalContracts.ts`","+  registers USDC (same address on chain 31337 and 8453) so the app can read","+  balances/allowance and call `approve`.","+- **Next.js forced onto webpack.** The `dev`/`start` scripts use `next dev","+  --webpack`. The RainbowKit → wagmi → Base Account connector transitively imports","+  optional `@x402/*` modules that aren't installed; a webpack `IgnorePlugin` in","+  `next.config.ts` ignores them (Turbopack ignores that config, hence `--webpack`).","+- **Node 25 `localStorage` polyfill.** Node 25 ships a built-in `localStorage`","+  missing `getItem`/`setItem`, which crashes SSR. The `dev`/`start` scripts","+  `--require ./polyfill-localstorage.cjs` to shim it.","+","+---","+","+## Not included (by design)","+","+This deliverable is the **working local project**. It is **not** deployed to any","+network, IPFS, or hosting provider."]}],"originalFile":"# 🏗 Scaffold-ETH 2\n\n<h4 align=\"center\">\n  <a href=\"https://docs.scaffoldeth.io\">Documentation</a> |\n  <a href=\"https://scaffoldeth.io\">Website</a>\n</h4>\n\n🧪 An open-source, up-to-date toolkit for building decentralized applications (dapps) on the Ethereum blockchain. It's designed to make it easier for developers to create and deploy smart contracts and build user interfaces that interact with those contracts.\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> 🤖 Scaffold-ETH 2 is AI-ready! It has everything agents need to build on Ethereum. Check `.agents/`, `.claude/`, `.opencode` or `.cursor/` for more info.\n\n⚙️ Built using NextJS, RainbowKit, Foundry, Wagmi, Viem, and Typescript.\n\n- ✅ **Contract Hot Reload**: Your frontend auto-adapts to your smart contract as you edit it.\n- 🪝 **[Custom hooks](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/)**: Collection of React hooks wrapper around [wagmi](https://wagmi.sh/) to simplify interactions with smart contracts with typescript autocompletion.\n- 🧱 [**Components**](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/): Collection of common web3 components to quickly build your frontend.\n- 🔥 **Burner Wallet & Local Faucet**: Quickly test your application with a burner wallet and local faucet.\n- 🔐 **Integration with Wallet Providers**: Connect to different wallet providers and interact with the Ethereum network.\n\n![Debug Contracts tab](https://github.com/scaffold-eth/scaffold-eth-2/assets/55535804/b237af0c-5027-4849-a5c1-2e31495cccb1)\n\n## Requirements\n\nBefore you begin, you need to install the following tools:\n\n- [Node (>= v20.18.3)](https://nodejs.org/en/download/)\n- Yarn ([v1](https://classic.yarnpkg.com/en/docs/install/) or [v2+](https://yarnpkg.com/getting-started/install))\n- [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)\n\n## Quickstart\n\nTo get started with Scaffold-ETH 2, follow the steps below:\n\n1. Install dependencies if it was skipped in CLI:\n\n```\ncd my-dapp-example\nyarn install\n```\n\n2. Run a local network in the first terminal:\n\n```\nyarn chain\n```\n\nThis command starts a local Ethereum network using Foundry. The network runs on your local machine and can be used for testing and development. You can customize the network configuration in `packages/foundry/foundry.toml`.\n\n3. On a second terminal, deploy the test contract:\n\n```\nyarn deploy\n```\n\nThis command deploys a test smart contract to the local network. The contract is located in `packages/foundry/contracts` and can be modified to suit your needs. The `yarn deploy` command uses the deploy script located in `packages/foundry/script` to deploy the contract to the network. You can also customize the deploy script.\n\n4. On a third terminal, start your NextJS app:\n\n```\nyarn start\n```\n\nVisit your app on: `http://localhost:3000`. You can interact with your smart contract using the `Debug Contracts` page. You can tweak the app config in `packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts`.\n\nRun smart contract test with `yarn foundry:test`\n\n- Edit your smart contracts in `packages/foundry/contracts`\n- Edit your frontend homepage at `packages/nextjs/app/page.tsx`. For guidance on [routing](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/defining-routes) and configuring [pages/layouts](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/pages-and-layouts) checkout the Next.js documentation.\n- Edit your deployment scripts in `packages/foundry/script`\n\n\n## Documentation\n\nVisit our [docs](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io) to learn how to start building with Scaffold-ETH 2.\n\nTo know more about its features, check out our [website](https://scaffoldeth.io).\n\n## Contributing to Scaffold-ETH 2\n\nWe welcome contributions to Scaffold-ETH 2!\n\nPlease see [CONTRIBUTING.MD](https://github.com/scaffold-eth/scaffold-eth-2/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information and guidelines for contributing to Scaffold-ETH 2.","userModified":false}}
